versionMeaning: Published semantic contract; existing HTTP payloads and SDK version unchanged; no new negotiation flag.

paths.POST /v1/client-effects/{effectId}/recei: authorized durable terminal receipt and optional parent resume command

authentication.cloud: Fresh verified HostGrant plus active Client Session for the same signed subject, Host, namespace and Origin
authentication.businessBff: Must map browser requests to fixed authorized Session/Task/Run and inject server-held native secrets; no arbitrary proxy

list.pagination: Existing bounded reconnect poll, not a complete scoped list; first50 candidates can exclude later authorized items.

responses.403: Insufficient signed scope or invalid current envelope
responses.404: Missing or other-resource effect; list omits other-resource rows
responses.409: Existing fence/revision/receipt conflict or projection not ready
responses.503: Required authority store unavailable; no success or empty fallback

receipt.lostResponse: Query current authorized effect status; replay same effect/idempotency key and consistent result, never re-execute business action automatically.

compatibility.history: No rewrite or deletion; terminal replay still requires current resource authority
compatibility.mixedVersions: Drain or upgrade all API/BFF routes handling effects before relying on this guard
compatibility.profileRevocation: No new claim of immediate running-effect cancellation or push revocation
compatibility.signedGrantRevocation: Already signed grants retain their validity window; no online revocation guarantee
